get.description: Returns the service names of the prepaid users.
Returns the names, activation email, licenses and state of the prepaid user, and the service names of the user and of its tenant. `isVirtual` tells whether it is a user slot or a real user.

put.description: Updates the first name, last name and activation email of the prepaid user.

post.description: Changes the password of the prepaid user and returns the task. Leave `password` empty to receive a generated password by email. Set `shouldSendMail` to send the new password to `notifyEmail`, the admin contact email by default.
Confirm service termination. Terminates the service with the token sent by email to the admin contact. A reason, a future use and a comment can be given.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The service name of your office account

futureUse.description: What next after your termination request

token.description: The termination token sent by email to the admin contact

get.description: Returns the tenant of the prepaid user: display name, contact details, service type, status, and whether the Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA) is accepted.

put.description: Updates the display name of the tenant of the prepaid user.

post.description: Accepts the Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA) for the parent tenant.

Creates a Microsoft Customer Agreement attestation for the parent tenant from the signatory company, names, email address, phone number, country and language. Returns the attestation ID and a link to the attestation that can be embedded in an iframe.

get.description: Get service information. Returns the status, creation and expiration dates, contacts and renewal settings of the service.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The service name of your office account

put.description: Update service information. Updates the renewal settings of the service: automatic renewal, period, or deletion at expiration.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The service name of your office account

get.description: Returns the IDs of the pending tasks of the parent tenant.
Returns the function, status, creation date and completion date of the task.
Returns, for each day between `from` and `to`, the peak and end-of-day counts of activated licenses of the parent tenant, by license type.

post.description: Request service termination. Starts the termination of the service. The admin contact receives a token by email, to confirm with the `confirmTermination` call.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The service name of your office account

post.description: Removes the configuration of the prepaid user and turns it back into an unassigned license slot, and returns the task. The prepaid license is kept.
